map.适用于稳态、近似点源、轴对称上升的火灾羽流，常见于中庭与大空间顶棚射流分析。非稳: It applies to steady, roughly point-source, axisymmetric rising fire plumes, common in atrium and large space ceiling jet analysis. Unsteady, strong wind or wall-attached fires deviate from it, so another model or CFD is needed.
map.烟气体积流量和温升怎么用？: How are the smoke volume flow rate and temperature rise used?
map.质量流量与温升用于估算烟气层下降速率与危害发展；体积流量与顶棚射流速度用于排烟口: The mass flow rate and temperature rise are used to estimate the smoke layer descent rate and hazard development; the volume flow rate and ceiling jet velocity are used for exhaust outlet layout and detection/sprinkler response judgement, and are the core inputs of performance-based design.
